prompt:
A few complaints about the `library/` checkout system this week:

- "A member returned their book one day late and still got charged a late fee - but our policy has a one-day grace period after the due date."
- "A member paid off their entire late-fee balance and we told them they're fine, but the system still says they're blocked from checking out - it only cleared up after we charged them a fee on an unrelated loan."
- "We registered a member as 'Alice' and now a different part of the app that looked her up as 'alice' says she doesn't exist."

`library/README.md` spells out exactly how checkout, returns, grace periods, the late-fee schedule, and blocking are supposed to work - please bring the code in line with it. Keep the existing public classes and function names (`Catalog`, `Members`, `Member`, `LibrarySystem`, `fee_for_billable_days`, etc.) and their signatures as-is, since other code already imports them.
